last.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook again, but its charging business is growing and a $2.00-per-share buyout offer from majority holder LS Power now sets the stock's anchor.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue guidance fell to $375-400M from $400-430M, and the adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $15-30M from $5-25M, extending August's reduced outlook.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: Majority holder LS Power proposed on Nov 2 to buy the remaining shares for $2.00 cash. The offer is non-binding, and an independent board committee is reviewing it.

takeaways.label: Core charging growing
takeaways.text: Charging revenue rose 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M as partner-built (eXtend) revenue halved. Usage per stall fell to 283 kWh/day from 295.

takeaways.label: Rising losses and cash drain
takeaways.text: Net loss grew 74% to $49.2M as admin costs rose 39%. Cash fell to $99M from $151M at year-end, while debt rose to $316M from $207M.

history.verdict: Investors sold EVgo after the company cut its full-year outlook and cash burn rose.

reasons.label: Lower 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Revenue guidance cut to $400-430M from $410-470M; below analysts' roughly $433M.

reasons.label: Bigger expected losses
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EBITDA now a $5-25M loss, versus a range reaching up to +$20M before.

reasons.label: Cash and slower ramp
reasons.text: Operating cash burn widened and new stalls ramped slower than hoped, despite Tesla deal.
